special_conditions: Beneficiary must have a 'standard' (regular repayment) loan account
SHGs must be registered with NRLM/NULM/NABARD with 2+ years credit history
Individual loan limit ₹2L, SHG loan limit ₹4L
Cannot claim interest subvention under multiple schemes simultaneously
